intro: Anachronos greets you as the one fate has been waiting a thousand years to bring forward, a champion to lead their people into a new age. This opens the end of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, and comes only after the Blue, Green and Red Scepter Shard forks are done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.
The Old God trembles, friend. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.
It knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is whole once more, friend.
It must be you who uses the scepter. It must be you who heralds the next age of your people.
You must wait for the armies of the Horde and the Alliance to arrive in Silithus before you may ring the Scarab Gong.
